name: Remembering Amie
source:
“Remembering Amie” is a short kinetic novel about Francis, who, on the cusp of adulthood, remembers his childhood friend Amie.

[From [url=http://lunasspecto.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]lunas specto[/url]]
translation:
《Remembering Amie》是一部簡短的無選項視覺小說，講述即將成年的法蘭西斯回憶童年好友艾咪的故事。

[出自[url=http://lunasspecto.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]lunas specto[/url]]
